{{Otheruses|Haven}}
[[File:Haven_es.jpg|thumb|right|250px|''Haven 3'' being disabled by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]].]]
'''Haven group''' was a trio of [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttles]] that were used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] deployed ''Haven'' shuttles in an attempt to kidnap [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. This plan was foiled, however, as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele's]] [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] aided in destroying the shuttles save for the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]], ''Haven 3'', which was disabled by Steele's [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]]. With [[Gender/Legends|his]] coup d'etat failed, Grand Admiral Zaarin escaped with his flagship the [[Glory (Imperial-class)|''Glory'']].
